h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jamalpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jamalpur

items.pText: Jamalpur, beside Munger on the Ganga, is home to one of India's oldest railway workshops, and the town has a long history of working with steel. Buyers here tend to ask detailed questions about how equipment is made, and we are glad to answer them. FunPlay Systems designs and fabricates playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,540 km away, and sends it to Bihar by road.

Two materials do most of the work in our equipment. Frames are made from galvanised steel pipe, while slides, panels, seats and roofs are roto-moulded plastic. Both are shaped in-house, and our raw materials are tested and certified before use. Knowing how each one behaves helps you look after it properly through Bihar's hot summers and humid monsoon. Our in-house quality inspection checks each piece before it leaves the factory, and we can explain any part of the process you want to understand.

richText.heading: How our main materials hold up outdoors

c: Galvanising bonds a layer of zinc to the steel pipe, and that layer goes on protecting the steel even where the surface gets scratched. Our galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Roto-moulding forms plastic parts in a heated, rotating mould, which gives a hollow one-piece shape with rounded edges and no joints to open up. Composite laminates and play rope, used on some ranges, are also covered for 3 years.

items.q: What is the difference between galvanised and painted steel?
items.a: Galvanised steel has a zinc coating bonded to it, which keeps protecting the steel when scratched. Painted steel starts to rust as soon as the paint chips, especially in a humid monsoon.

items.q: Why are slides and panels roto-moulded?
items.a: Roto-moulding makes strong, hollow, one-piece parts with rounded edges and colour right through the plastic. They do not rust, and they clean easily with water and a soft cloth.

items.q: Do you supply Jamalpur and Munger?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to Jamalpur, Munger and nearby towns by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
